user.title: Create a Mobility Forecast profile
user.description: Each profile is configured and updated independently.

data_description.name: A display name for this independent forecast profile.
data_description.calendar_entity_ids: Select one or more calendars to read. Their order is preserved.
data_description.start_anchor_entity_id: Select the Home Assistant zone where a forecast day begins.
data_description.end_anchor_entity_id: Select the Home Assistant zone where a forecast day ends. This is independent from the start anchor.
data_description.physical_event_policy: Explicitly include or exclude events classified as physical.
data_description.online_event_policy: Explicitly include or exclude events classified as online.
data_description.all_day_event_policy: Explicitly include or exclude all-day events.
data_description.no_location_event_policy: Explicitly include or exclude physical events without a location. Online events never require a physical location.
data_description.route_provider: Select the provider for future road-distance requests. No request is made while creating the profile.
data_description.route_provider_api_key: Stored as private Home Assistant configuration and never included in entity attributes or diagnostics.
data_description.toll_policy: Explicitly allow or avoid toll roads.
